purpose: Make History GO place production cheaper and faster by reusing verified research, claims and canonical entities across places without reducing content scope, editorial richness, factuality or any existing place-production quality gate.
core_principle: Research can be shared; quality approval cannot. Every place must still be produced as a rich, place-specific History GO experience under the complete canonical place checklist and all subsystem contracts.

research_model.rule: Group research only when sources, historical episodes, people, institutions, natural systems or other evidence genuinely overlap. Never group places merely to save cost if doing so weakens place-specific understanding.
sequence: search existing canonical research and entities
assemble shared source/evidence pack where genuine overlap exists
build or reuse explicit claims with place/entity scope
perform additional place-specific research until the complete checklist can be fulfilled at the highest supportable quality
review and approve each place independently through the full checklist

claim_bank.principle: A fact is researched once when the evidence is already sufficient, then reused through explicit claim references instead of rediscovered for every surface or place.
claim_bank.scope_rule: Area-level or shared evidence may only be reused for a place when the claim explicitly supports that place. Shared context is not permission to restamp a general claim as a place-specific fact.
claim_bank.dedupe_rule: Before researching or creating a claim, search existing place production packages, People claims, Stories, relations, routes, Fagverk evidence, quiz production contexts and other canonical claim stores for equivalent evidence.
claim_bank.richness_rule: Claim reuse is a research optimization, not a text reuse strategy. The same claim may support different place-specific narratives, observations, quizzes or relations, but each final surface must be written for the actual place.

source_pack.rule: The source pack is an evidence library. It does not define how much content a place gets and does not replace place-specific research where the complete checklist identifies a gap.

freshness_classes.historical_stable: Stable historical claim. Reuse is allowed without rediscovery unless a conflict, correction or stronger source appears.
freshness_classes.institutional_periodic: Institutional function, ownership, operator or similar fact that can change. Reverify when the place is materially revised or the owning contract requires it.
freshness_classes.current_volatile: Current business, opening status, event, news, access, hours or other time-sensitive fact. Fresh verification is required under the owning subsystem contract.
freshness_classes.source_volatile: The fact may be stable but the source itself is unstable. Preserve provenance and maintain/replace the source as needed.

deterministic_first.principle: Do not spend model reasoning on work that code or existing canonical data can do exactly.
tasks: search and resolve existing canonical IDs
find existing People, Objects, Brands, Stories, routes and relations
reuse source IDs and reviewed locators
run source freshness and integrity audits
run subsystem tests and browser verification
detect exact and near-duplicate place-authored text across batch outputs
deterministic_first.quality_rule: Deterministic work may remove repetitive labor only; it may not generate unsupported editorial conclusions or bypass a manual/editorial gate.

model_use.principle: Use strong reasoning whenever it materially improves research, source criticism, synthesis, pedagogy or editorial quality. The goal is not to minimize model use at the expense of quality; the goal is to stop paying repeatedly for the same context and deterministic work.
model_use.batch_context_rule: When multiple places genuinely share reviewed source context, provide that context once and request structured per-place candidates in the same reasoning pass where useful.
model_use.per_place_followup_rule: If any place needs additional research or deeper synthesis after the shared pass, run the additional work. Cost is never a reason to stop before the full checklist and quality bar are met.
model_use.candidate_only: Model output is never publishable merely because it is structured, fluent or passes schema validation. It must pass the complete per-place editorial and subsystem gates.

anti_generic_quality_gate.principle: Shared research must produce richer local content, not templated local content.

tests.rule: If a place-authored paragraph remains substantially correct after replacing the place name with another same-category place, it is presumed generic and must be rewritten or removed.

Every substantive visible section must be grounded in place-specific evidence such as a documented event, person, object, physical feature, use, date/period, relation, production, local language feature, natural feature or other distinguishing fact.
Exact or near-duplicate place-authored prose across places is a blocker when it differs mainly by names or superficial substitutions. Shared canonical UI copy is exempt.
Distinctive factual statements must trace to reviewed claims/source locators or explicit canonical entity relations.
Manual review must be able to state what the player can learn, notice, compare, understand or do at this specific place that is not supplied by generic area/category prose.

The place must not be declared complete while relevant, source-supported People, Objects, Brands, Stories, Quiz/Knowledge, language, history, before/after, routes, observations or other checklist surfaces remain materially underproduced.

full_content_rule.definition: Full content means all relevant checklist surfaces are actively researched and produced to the highest quality the evidence can support. A surface is N/A only because the subsystem is genuinely irrelevant or the evidence does not support it after appropriate research, never because the place was assigned a cheaper production class.
required_behavior: seek additional evidence when shared sources are insufficient
produce rich place-specific descriptions and history
produce all relevant canonical entity relationships
produce Stories when a real narrative episode exists
produce Quiz/Knowledge when the place supports meaningful learning
produce language/local-expression content when supported by the language contract
produce before/after, observations, routes and other experiential content when evidence and assets support them
perform manual visual and editorial QA after technical gates

economy_metrics.purpose: Measure avoided duplicate work without turning efficiency into a product target.
economy_metrics.anti_metric: No raw count, reuse ratio, token budget, model-call count or cost target may be used as evidence that a place is complete or as justification for reducing content.

rollout.pilot_rule: Pilot the smarter research method on one coherent Oslo cluster while every place still follows the complete existing checklist.
rollout.comparison: Compare against recent one-place production for editorial richness, place specificity, source traceability, checklist completeness, manual quality and total duplicate research/model context.
rollout.scale_gate: Scale only if duplicate work falls without any reduction in content richness, checklist completeness, factuality, source traceability or manual quality. Any quality regression blocks scaling until the method is fixed.
